gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.269893 43.680714)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.269893 43.680714)',4326)::geography,
        4800
      )
  AND amenity = 'restaurant';

WITH arboretum_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-70.269893, 43.680714), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
restaurant_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-76.607365, 39.286973), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
distance_between AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(arboretum_point.geom, restaurant_point.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM arboretum_point, restaurant_point
),
elevation_at_restaurant AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_Value(r.rast, r.geom))::int AS elevation_meters
  FROM restaurant_point r
  JOIN public.dem_us d ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
)
SELECT 
  distance_between.distance_meters,
  elevation_at_restaurant.elevation_meters
FROM distance_between, elevation_at_restaurant;
